I am a Postdoctoral Researcher at the Max Planck Institute for Software Systems hosted by Prof. Sadegh Soudjani. Prior to this, I completed my PhD from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur under Prof. Indranil Saha. My doctoral research was supported by the prestigious Prime Minister Research Fellowship.
My research interest lies in the area of Learning-based Controller Synthesis. I work mostly in designing Safe, Robust and Efficient algorithms for Embodied AI systems.
